title: Circular - Launch of Virtual Traffic Court for Traffic eChallans from the whole State of Gujarat
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 03-05-2023 REGISTRAR GENERAL

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
C I R C U L A R
Launch of Virtual Traffic Court at Metropolitan Courts, Ahmedabad
for Traffic eChallans from the whole State of Gujarat
As directed, this is to convey for the benefit of all the stakeholders
that, upon successful integration of One Nation One Challan project with
Traffic Police Challans and RTO Challans in the State of Gujarat, the Virtual
Traffic Court under the aegis of the eCourts Project has been implemented
with guidance from the eCommittee of Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and
assistance from NIC team at Pune, Maharashtra.
As per approval and guidance of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Mr. Justice A. J. Desai also the Chairperson of the I. T. Committee of the
High Court and Hon’ble Judges of the I. T. Committee, the Virtual Traffic
Court, designated at Metropolitan Court, Ahmedabad has been made
operational w.e.f. today the 3rd May, 2023.
Virtual Traffic court has been designed with an objective to eliminate
the need for litigants to appear in person at court, as the Virtual Court
system allows the Court users and vehicle owners to complete all the
proceedings online.
If an eChallan fine amount is not paid within 90 days, the eChallan is
automatically transmitted to the servers of Virtual Traffic Court. Upon the
Virtual Traffic Court taking up the matter and proceeding to issue notice,
SMS notice would be sent to the mobile phone of the vehicle owner.
Thereafter, the vehicle owner can pay up the fine imposed by the Virtual
Traffic Court through online payment mode or choose to contest the case in
the regular Court.
The Virtual Court access link is https://vcourts.gov.in/virtualcourt/.
User help documentation is available on Gujarat High Court website at
https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/virtualtrafficcourt
Sd/-
Date: 03-05-2023 REGISTRAR GENERAL
To,
1. The Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Ahmedabad.
2. The Additional Chief Secretary (Home), Govt. of Gujarat
3. The Secretary, Legal Department, Govt. of Gujarat
4. The Inspector General of Police (State Traffic Branch), Govt. of Gujarat.
5. The Transport Commissioner, Commissionerate of Transport, Govt. of
Gujarat.
6. NIC eChallan Team at Gandhinagar and NIC - HQ at New Delhi
